verdict.rationale: The pricing page says the Fancy tier includes 'Unlimited parallel generations' and a 'Priority queue', which is first-party information on concurrency and queueing for one plan. It is only a single feature-list mention and does not document actual limits or queue mechanics. missing for 10: concurrency limits for other tiers and the API, queue ordering/wait-time behavior, batch rendering submission semantics, rate-limit and backpressure documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline

citations.quote: Included: Unlimited parallel generations ... Included: Priority queue
